mapper.sql: g.id, g.map_id, g.origin, g.title, g.body, g.source_url, g.created_at, g.updated_at
id, map_id, origin, title, body, source_url, created_at, updated_at

EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.travel_map m JOIN public.user_account a ON a.id = #{actorId,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler} WHERE m.id = g.map_id AND a.status = 1 AND (m.owner_id = a.id OR (a.role = 'admin' AND m.visibility = 'public')) )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.guide g JOIN public.travel_map m ON m.id = g.map_id WHERE g.map_id = #{mapId,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler} AND (m.visibility = 'public' OR m.owner_id = #{viewerId,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler}) ORDER BY g.created_at DESC, g.id

SELECT FROM public.guide g JOIN public.travel_map m ON m.id = g.map_id WHERE g.id = #{guideId,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler} AND g.map_id = #{mapId,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler} AND (m.visibility = 'public' OR m.owner_id = #{viewerId,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler})

SELECT FROM public.guide g JOIN public.pin_guide l ON l.guide_id = g.id JOIN public.travel_map m ON m.id = g.map_id WHERE l.pin_id = #{pinId,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler} AND g.map_id = #{mapId,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler} AND (m.visibility = 'public' OR m.owner_id = #{viewerId,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler}) ORDER BY l.position, g.created_at, g.id

SELECT l.guide_id, l.pin_id, l.position FROM public.pin_guide l JOIN public.guide g ON g.id = l.guide_id JOIN public.travel_map m ON m.id = g.map_id WHERE l.guide_id = #{guideId,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler} AND g.map_id = #{mapId,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler} AND (m.visibility = 'public' OR m.owner_id = #{viewerId,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler}) ORDER BY l.position, l.pin_id

SELECT l.guide_id, l.pin_id, l.position FROM public.pin_guide l JOIN public.guide g ON g.id = l.guide_id JOIN public.travel_map m ON m.id = g.map_id WHERE g.map_id = #{mapId,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler} AND (m.visibility = 'public' OR m.owner_id = #{viewerId,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler}) ORDER BY g.created_at, g.id, l.position, l.pin_id

SELECT l.pin_id, g.id AS guide_id, g.title, g.source_url FROM public.pin_guide l JOIN public.guide g ON g.id = l.guide_id JOIN public.travel_map m ON m.id = g.map_id WHERE g.map_id = #{mapId,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler} AND (m.visibility = 'public' OR m.owner_id = #{viewerId,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler}) ORDER BY g.created_at, g.id, l.position, l.pin_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.pin_guide (guide_id, pin_id, position) VALUES (#{guideId,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler}, #{pinId,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler}, #{position})
